Definition: Janoach or Janochah, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Janoah was a town on the border of Ephraim, where the boundary passed eastward toward Taanath-shiloh. Centuries later Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria took Janoah with the cities of Naphtali and carried the people captive.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same ground can hold a boundary and a captivity, and Janoah remembers both the gift and the loss.
